changelog.zh:
- 修复：RTSP 流报 Protocol 'rtsp' not on whitelist 无法播放，将 rtsp 加入 mpv protocol-whitelist
- 新增：回看（catchup）时间参数支持，对齐 Kodi pvr.iptvsimple 标准与 rtp2httpd（${utc}/${utcend}/${timestamp}/${duration}、${(b/e)yyyyMMddHHmmss:UTC}、${offset}、{utc:格式} 等）
- 新增：自动（安全）硬解方案下可配置 vf=d3d11vpp 去交错参数（bob/adaptive/mocomp/off），非安全方案隐藏且不生效
- 移除：Vulkan 硬解方案（RTX 3080 Ti 上 h264 Vulkan 解码初始化崩溃）
- 优化：避免硬解非法模式残留（windows_hwdec_mode 校验回退 auto-safe）
changelog.en:
- Fix: RTSP streams failed with Protocol 'rtsp' not on whitelist; added rtsp to mpv protocol-whitelist
- New: Catchup time parameter support aligned with Kodi pvr.iptvsimple and rtp2httpd (${utc}/${utcend}/${timestamp}/${duration}, ${(b/e)yyyyMMddHHmmss:UTC}, ${offset}, {utc:format}, etc.)
- New: Configurable vf=d3d11vpp deinterlace parameters (bob/adaptive/mocomp/off) under Auto (Safe) hardware decode mode; hidden/inactive for non-safe modes
- Removed: Vulkan hardware decode mode (h264 Vulkan init crashed on RTX 3080 Ti)
- Optimization: Guard against invalid hardware decode mode residue (windows_hwdec_mode validated back to auto-safe)
